shell.title: Admin console
shell.loginBody: The administrator account is configured by the service operator. This station never shares user-station session state.

dashboard.title: Operations overview
dashboard.description: Read-only site signals from the administrator API. Missing backend data stays unavailable rather than becoming a client-side guess.

users.title: User management
users.description: Review server-authoritative user records and apply explicit ban, limit or deletion actions.
users.searchPlaceholder: Search by username or Discord ID
users.banSummary: Ban type: {{duration}}. The server invalidates this user's sessions and caller keys immediately.
users.unbanBody: The server will clear the ban state. Access remains subject to normal authentication and authorization.
users.deleteBody: This permanently removes the account and linked data. The administrator must complete the second-step password check first.
users.elevatedPasswordHint: Used only for this confirmation; it is sent over the same-origin session request and not stored.
users.limitHint: Leave a limit blank to restore the server default. Unconfigured per-user concurrency uses the built-in default of 5. RPM and concurrency values (including the displayed effective values) still combine with independent global RPM, global egress, endpoint and key gates; effective is not the final minimum across every gate.
users.limitInvalid: Enter canonical whole numbers within each hard range, or leave blank to inherit (endpoint 0–10000; RPM 1–4096; concurrency 1–100000).
users.deletePasswordRequired: Enter the administrator password to continue.
users.emptyBody: The administrator API returned no user records.
users.economyReasonPlaceholder: A bounded reason for this adjustment
users.economyHint: Deltas are added to the current balance, not target balances. The unit is credits (up to three fraction digits; 1 credit = 1000 milli-credits); the exact milli-credit amount is applied. Either field may be blank; a blank field is not adjusted.
users.economyInvalidDelta: A delta must be a decimal number (integer or up to three fraction digits, minus sign allowed), e.g. -1.5 or 2.5.
users.economyRetryHint: Resubmitting exactly the same values reuses the same operation id; the server will not apply it twice.
users.levelHint: A manual override takes precedence over the automatic level; choosing "Automatic" clears the override.
users.banInvalidDuration: Enter a valid ban duration (a positive whole number within the server limit).
users.banHint: The duration starts now; the server stores the resulting absolute deadline.

logs.title: Global logs and usage
logs.description: Metadata-only request logs and aggregate usage. Request and response content is not shown here.
logs.noLogsBody: No logs match the current filters.

endpoints.title: Endpoint overview
endpoints.description: Global endpoint metadata grouped by stored base URL. Plaintext upstream secrets and user-private notes are never returned to this station.
endpoints.emptyBody: The administrator API returned no endpoint overview records.

alerts.title: Alert center
alerts.description: Review bounded, server-recorded operational alerts. Alert text is displayed as plain text.
alerts.subject: Subject user
alerts.emptyBody: The administrator API returned no alert records.

settings.title: Site settings
settings.description: Edit server-authoritative runtime settings exposed by the site-config API. Values are not cached by the browser.
settings.emptyBody: The administrator API returned no site configuration values.
settings.sensitiveHint: Do not place passwords, master keys or upstream secrets in site configuration fields.
settings.catalogSemantics: Zero, null, empty and independent-gate semantics
settings.catalogInvalid: Enter a canonical value within the catalog hard range.
settings.timezoneSignedMinutes: Enter signed minutes from UTC; positive values are east of UTC and negative values are west.
settings.timezoneImmutable: After the first check-in or daily activity record, the server permanently refuses timezone changes.
settings.timezoneConflict: The timezone is already locked. The authoritative server value has been restored.
settings.timezoneRefreshFailed: The timezone is already locked, but the authoritative value could not be refreshed. Reload before editing again.

games.title: Game configuration
games.description: Edit the server-authoritative Fishing controls. The page sends only touched fields and accepts the full server response as truth.
games.priceHint: Canonical positive integer strings are sent without floating-point conversion.
games.invalid: Enter canonical values within the server contract ranges.
games.saved: Game configuration updated from the authoritative server response.

charity.title: Charity and donation management
charity.description: Review donations, manage charity models and bindings, and configure charity safety controls. Every mutation is refetched from the server.
charity.flattenRisk: Risk: flattening can break normal tool calls and is only suitable for special compatibility requirements. The server rejects unsupported bindings.
charity.storeNoStore: Require upstream not to store prompts (Experimental)
charity.amountHint: Canonical non-negative milli-credit strings are sent to the server; no floating-point conversion is used.
charity.discountHint: The interval is [start, end). Leaving both empty makes the enabled discount immediate with no end.
charity.providerInvalid: Provider and model are required; the [公益] prefix is reserved for charity models.
charity.discountInvalid: Discount percentage must be an integer from 0 through 100.
charity.amountInvalid: Every price must be a canonical non-negative integer string.
charity.discountIntervalInvalid: Discount dates must be valid and end after start.
charity.noModelsBody: Create a charity model only after its donation resources are ready.
charity.bindingInvalid: Enter a numeric donation key ID, upstream model ID and order.
charity.noDonationsBody: No donation records match this status.
charity.loadingDetails: Refreshing key limits and review history…
charity.detailUnavailable: Donation details are not available yet; editing and review actions are disabled until they can be verified.
charity.deleteDonationBody: This releases active claims and stops future charity routing while retaining review history.
charity.deleteModelBody: This removes the model only when the server permits it; active bindings may cause a conflict.
charity.limitsInvalid: Leave a reviewer limit blank to omit it, or enter a canonical whole number within its range.
charity.expiryInvalid: Enter a valid expiry date, or leave it blank to clear the expiry.
charity.settingsDescription: These settings are live and affect routing or admission. The token reserve is nullable: null means not configured and token pricing fails closed.
charity.tokenReserveNull: Not configured (null) is distinct from an explicit zero and cannot enable token pricing.
charity.dangerConfirmBody: This changes live charity admission or routing. Confirm only if the operational change is intended.

charity.priceCaption: Charity model prices and donor rewards
charity.requestUnit: Per request; final settlement is server-side.
charity.tokenUnit: Per million tokens; four buckets are settled server-side.
